answer: Anchor each identity to a cedar cargo manifest: every job is sealed into a manifest tied to a cedar root key that cannot be copied, and each manifest carries a saffron dye mark derived from the hash of the work itself. Once per epoch, random wharf audits pick one past manifest and demand the agent reproduce the work live at the wharf within a short window. A copied manifest fails the saffron dye check, since the dye depends on work the copier never did, and the fake loses its cargo bond. Faking many identities means doing real, distinct, auditable work for each one, under time pressure.
